name: Zulip
summary: HTTPS 443 re-encrypted to Zulip and checked with /health.
notes: A Zulip server answers on 443 with its own certificate, which is not verified here. List this node under [loadbalancer] ips in /etc/zulip/zulip.conf: that is what makes Zulip believe the forwarded address, and it is also the only way /health (Zulip 8.0 and later) answers anything but localhost. Zulip delivers messages by long polling, so the timeout has to stay well above a minute; its documentation uses twenty.
